metadata.description: One workflow for Jev question design: find, fit, draft, lint, spread, threshold, cascade.

plugins.name: jev-pipeline
plugins.description: Find decision-shaped LLM calls in a codebase, judge whether Jev / TypeSafe System One fits them, draft typed Choice/Score/Noul questions from field-tested patterns, lint them, calibrate thresholds on hard cases, and plan act/pass/escalate bands.
